title: Identify the full names of members who either (a) incurred a 'Pizza' expens
question: Identify the full names of members who either (a) incurred a 'Pizza' expense between $50 and $100 for any event, or (b) attended a 'Meeting' event in 2020 and have a 'Medium' t-shirt size. Include only those members who meet at least one of these two conditions.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_035", m."XCL_036"
FROM member AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense AS e
    WHERE e."XCL_022" = m."XCL_034"
      AND e."XCL_018" = 'Pizza'
      AND e."XCL_020" BETWEEN 50 AND 100
)
OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS ev ON a."XCL_001" = ev."XCL_010"
    WHERE a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_034"
      AND ev."XCL_013" = 'Meeting'
      AND ev."XCL_012" LIKE '2020%'
      AND m."XCL_039" = 'Medium'
);
